description_en: Queries the total number of messages in a topic and the status of the topic
description_zh: 查询当前Topic下的消息总量以及Topic的状态
name: OnsTopicStatus

parameters.help_en: The name of the topic that you want to query
parameters.name: topic

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance that contains the topic you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的Topic所对应的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

Data.description_en: The data structure of the queried topic
Data.description_zh: 查询到的Topic的信息存储数据结构

LastTimeStamp.description_en:
The point in time when the latest message is ready in the topic. If no message exists in the topic, the return value of this parameter is 0.

The value of this parameter is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

For information about the definition of ready messages and ready time, see [Terms]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29533.html）
LastTimeStamp.description_zh:
当前Topic内最新一条消息的就绪时间，如果Topic内没有消息，则该参数返回值为0。

该参数值的格式为毫秒级Unix时间戳。

就绪消息及就绪时间具体含义，请参见[名词解释]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29533.html）

Perm.description_en:
Indicates the operations that you can perform on the topic. Valid values:

2: You can publish messages to the topic.

4: You can subscribe to the topic.

6: You can publish messages to and subscribe to the topic
Perm.description_zh:
所有关系编号。取值说明如下：

2：可以发布
4：可以订阅
6：可以发布和订阅

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of messages in all partitions of the topic
TotalCount.description_zh: 当前Topic的所有分区存在的消息数总和

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This parameter is a common parameter. Each request has a unique ID. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
